title: Tirar frente a tirar
reviewer: R33 local source-followup; manual source-to-claim review

semanticReview.method: Revisión semántica manual contra las fuentes primarias enlazadas en Evidence; se cotejaron los sentidos/afirmaciones materiales con los localizadores registrados. Se excluyeron de la redacción final las generalizaciones no respaldadas.

findings.summary: Michaelis documents Brazilian Portuguese tirar with senses and examples for removing clothing, obtaining a result, and taking photographs, and the entry dúvida lists tirar uma dúvida as clarifying something not understood; the DLE documents Spanish tirar with senses including intentionally dropping, throwing in a direction, and discarding.
